intro: Sargeron is the crumbled ruin of an ancient night elf city located in northern Desolace. Shattered during the Great Sundering, its former temples of Elune have been defiled and claimed by the Hatefury satyrs, who renamed the grounds in tribute to their master, Sargeras.

p: Before the War of the Ancients broke the continent, this settlement was a flourishing center of worship dedicated to Elune, housing sacred grounds such as Elune's Temple, Sanctuary, and Cathedral. Its true name is lost to antiquity. When the world shattered, the city collapsed into rubble, leaving behind sanctified relics like the Cup of Elune, Elune's Brazier, and Elune's Handmaiden. In the millennia since, corrupted Hatefury satyrs overran the stones, repurposing the sacred Kaldorei architecture into a stronghold honoring the titan Sargeras.
